title: Living Weapons
subtitle: They hunger
text: Living Weapons are the pinnacle of Hemomancy combat. The Living Blade, Living Axe, Living Spear, Living Baghnakh, and Living Crossbow are all blood-powered and do not lose durability. Instead they consume Blood Volume with each strike. The Sanguis Lancea is a throwable blood javelin. These weapons grow stronger with your mastery of blood.
